subject.title: fix(telegram): time out incomplete Mini App auth bodies

question: Should installRequestBodyLimitGuard become a supported plugin-SDK ingress API, or should the existing public JSON-body reader be upgraded to preserve response-before-destroy ordering?
rationale: Both paths alter the shared plugin contract or its behavior; the current direct internal import violates the package boundary, and selecting the permanent SDK shape needs owner intent.

options.title: Extend the public ingress API
options.body: Export the guard from the documented webhook-ingress surface, add package/export and compatibility coverage, then import it from that public barrel.

options.title: Repair the existing public reader
options.body: Move response-before-destroy ordering into readJsonWebhookBodyOrReject so Telegram uses the already supported public ingress API without adding another guard call.

recommendation.title: Extend the public ingress API
recommendation.body: Export the guard from the documented webhook-ingress surface, add package/export and compatibility coverage, then import it from that public barrel.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the stable plugin-SDK boundary rather than Telegram-only behavior.
